title: 🚀 [Feature] UserSettings - Delete Account & Data
body: > [](https://github.com/ulfgebhardt) **Authored by [ulfgebhardt](https://github.com/ulfgebhardt)** _Apr 4, 2019_ _Closed Jun 14, 2019_ --- ## 🚀 Feature ### UserSettings - Delete Account & Data ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1238238/55569372-bed93300-5701-11e9-8b30-81cd56862388.png) - [ ] Confirm slider - [ ] Delete Button + Functionality Note: It could be sufficient to send an email if the delete functionality is provided to an admin ### Userstory ``` Feature: Delete own account and content As a user I'd like to delete all my data, ie. posts, comments, shouts, follows Because I have a "right to be forgotten" ``` ### Design & Layout - Alpha ![Screenshot at 2019-06-04 19:35:58.png](https://images.zenhubusercontent.com/5ac663b44b5806bc2bcdd1d7/e0818ed3-1d02-42c7-9a4f-48a340d0b87a) ### Design & Layout - Nitro Not implemented: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1238238/55569449-e6300000-5701-11e9-875b-b2bbe347a4a2.png)
